resources.string: Input
Where the run starts: your message, a shared page, or the prompt a trigger carries.
Output
Where the run ends and the answer reaches you.
LiteRT
One inference step on the model running on the phone.
Cloud
One inference step against a configured cloud provider.
Intent Router
Sorts the incoming text into one of the classes you declare and sends the run down the matching branch — the way to give one pipeline several behaviours.
If Condition
A two-way branch: a yes/no question about the input, or a deterministic check for whether the run carries an image.
Clarification
Pauses the run to ask you a question and waits for the answer, which then becomes the node\'s output.
Tool
Calls one tool — a built-in, an AppFunction from another app, or one published by an MCP server — and passes the result on.
Decomposition
Turns one instruction into a list of subtasks.
Queue Processor
Walks a list of subtasks one at a time, sending each down the Item branch and taking the Done branch when the list is empty.
Evaluation
Judges what the previous step produced and answers Pass, Retry or Fail — the node that lets a pipeline have another go instead of handing you a bad answer.
Summary
Condenses what several earlier steps produced into one piece of text, typically just before the Output node at the end of a loop.
Pipeline
Runs another saved pipeline as a single step and returns its answer — a function call between pipelines, and the way to reuse a branch instead of copying it.
Skill
Runs a reusable skill: a fixed instruction plus the list of tools that skill may use.
